notes.title: 21/4/4 Update
notes.content:
1. After much consideration, we decided to ease the difficulty in Babymode.
- Line length has been increased considerably in Babymode.
- In Babymode, there is now a rare chance that our friend 'Kiria' will teleport you to the location before it fell.

[b]2. Shortcuts existed in the previous gas dragon section and windy section.[/b]
This part was a difficult route designed with the intention of shortening the time, but it turned out to be easier than expected.
A lot of people passed the gas dragon section.
We would like to correct this part.

- The shortcut described above has now been corrected to appear after the 'falling dragon' section.
- Weakened the wind strength in the windy section.
- Adjusted the duration of strong winds in the windy section to be shorter.

[b]3. Reset Ranking[/b]
Since there are important map modifications above, we decided to proceed with the average clearing time taken into account.
Rankings prior to this update are stored in the community.

Please understand that it was translated with a translator. Thank you.

notes.title: 리아 탄생 3주년 업데이트
notes.content:
Hello, this is Fossil. The update we talked about before has been in progress.

First of all, we ask for your understanding that we will notify you of the news through a google translator.

Again, I would like to focus on the main point and focus on the subject.


[b]1. Graphic reorganization[/b]
In fact, 3 years ago, Ria's Hook showed ridiculously low quality even on PCs to implement both mobile and PC at the same time. However, with this update, we tried to implement graphics suitable for the PC platform.

[b]2. Steam linkage solution and ranking introduction [/b]
This time, by solving the problem of interlocking with Steam, you can use the functions provided by the existing Steam. Rankings are introduced in this update, so you can easily compete by looking at other users' time attack records.
Also, in order to create a competitive spirit, ranking #1 user gets crowned when she plays the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32385526/3793e195f3eb5f3943d00e131fbe0f11120afc69.png[/img]

[b]3. Absurd map structure reorganization and bug fixes [/b]
With the introduction of rankings, the Meteor section, which previously contributed greatly to luck, has been corrected for a fair game. Meteor will now come down in a uniform pattern and try to break Ria's head. Instead, it was designed to be more difficult than before, taking into account that the difficulty level was lowered due to the detection of the pattern.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32385526/0cb1766aba2c398c4f311553e196bb8b8cfa1cc8.png[/img]

In previous versions of Ria's Hook, there was an absurd situation, starting from scratch, often stuck in sharp corners. This phenomenon has also been corrected so that when it is caught in the corner, it moves in the left or right direction with probability so that it does not get caught in the corner.

The map hasn't changed much, but the map has been modified by re-adjusting the difficulty of some ambiguous sections.

[b]4. Regarding the feeling of control [/b]
Ah. This is really an April Fools joke~

[b]5. Babymode [/b]
Now, we have updated it to appease users who are aiming to clear. In Babymode, the hook determination is better, and the current location is saved even after the game is ended, allowing you to enjoy the game comfortably. However, rankings are not recorded, and you will receive a little(?) shame .

[b]6. Addition of challenges and hidden things[/b]
Find 2 added treasures and hidden secrets!
And not only challenges are achieved! When you reach the challenge, we'll give you accessories, outfits, and emotes to decorate our cute Ria!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32385526/59e9282962ea4ab097ec0a3be379f6e09be311fc.png[/img]

This concludes the update notice. Thank you.

Because of my lack of ability, I would like to have had since the day of game release. People who are already clear and have collected all the artifacts will be angry, but what can I do? Life is a repetition of agony. If you want to achievement, you can turn this painful game back on.

notes.title: 2018/04/12 patch
notes.content:
- It makes one slippery footboard flat and now does not slip well.

- The length of the trunk is slightly increased at the entrance of the gap, so you can see without jumping.

- The wind speed is slightly stronger. However, the wind intensity in the final section weakened.

- Slightly reduced the size of the big void fragments at the foot of the bridge and the next step.

- Slightly reduced the size of the small void fragments in the final section.

- The speed of the blue dragon caught when entering the final section has increased.

- The frequency of launch of Meteor in the last section has changed.
Randomly between 5 and 8 seconds => 6.75 seconds



I forgot the most important thing.

-Ria's crying cooldown has been reduced from 8 seconds to 3 seconds.

※A void fragment is a black object with red eyes.
